name: Sotoonda
description: From their dark and stately towers atop a broad seamount, the Ündercï claim authority over the underwave, which teems with civilizations to rival the land. This largely undisputed authority was shaken by the warnings of prominent scholar Parmen’Ides, who told of an impending abyssal emergence of terrifying scale. Her warnings were met with anger and she was cast out. Almost immediately, the Potluck Plague - seeming not to discriminate between the land or the sea - fell upon Sotoonda. Given its origins among the Rospogenti, tensions between the surface and sea kingdoms were greatly exacerbated by competing recriminations. The timing of the plague lent great credence and weight to Parmen’Ides’ warnings. Many of the Underci clamor for her return…
